Horrible atención en la tienda full de Leandro, no solo conmigo si no con clientes posteriores a mi.  Muy poco amable y cara de pocos amigos. Entiendo q recién empieza el turno, será q no lo deje desayunar tranquilo? Quería agregar q se han comunicado conmigo para pedirme disculpas y me invitaron a volver. Agradezco este gesto de Leandro.

(Translated by Google)
Terrible service at Leandro's store, not only to me but to customers after me as well. Very unfriendly and unfriendly. I understand he's just starting his shift; perhaps I didn't let him have breakfast in peace? I wanted to add that they contacted me to apologize and invited me to return. I appreciate Leandro's gesture.
